# Theory: The Reflog is a Local Journal of Names

Every time a ref in this clone moves, Git can append a line to that ref’s log. It is not replicated. It is not a backup of other clones.

## Invariants

1. `HEAD` and each branch can have a reflog.
2. Default expire is on the order of 30 days (`gc.reflogExpire`).
3. `HEAD@{1}` is “where HEAD was last time,” not “parent commit.”
4. Recovering a deleted branch is `git switch -c name <hash-from-reflog>`.

```text
main moved C → D → E
reflog  E HEAD@{0}
        D HEAD@{1}
        C HEAD@{2}     (local only)
```

## What can break

- Expecting a teammate’s reflog to contain your amended commit.
- `gc --prune=now` after expire.

## How to read this chapter

How it works, recover a branch, the 30-day window, step-by-step scenarios.
